bullet: PATCH on an unknown id (`F04.patch-unknown-id`), known bug.
script:
control-agent-server api GET /openapi.json --check 'paths.<redacted:session-cookie>/{conversation_id}.patch.responses.404' exists --quiet
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOPE" --expect 404
control-agent-server api PATCH "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOPE" --json '{"title": "QA nobody"}' --expect 404 --save F04.patch-unknown-id/unknown  # bug
